clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert with collection containing JSON field 'meta', first insert valid JSON object {"important": "data"}, then upsert string value "invalid_json" for same field
clean_repro.observed: Upsert succeeds (HTTP 200), query returns corrupted data: meta field changed from {"important": "data"} to "invalid_json" (string instead of JSON object)
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: python -c "import requests; r = requests.post('http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/query', json={'collectionName': 'test_json', 'filter': 'id in [0,1]', 'outputFields': ['meta']}); print(r.json())"

contract_refs: JSON field should maintain JSON object structure; accepting primitive string for JSON dataType violates data integrity

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 upsert request → handler_v2.go:upsert() → anyToColumns() → DataType_JSON case → unsafe .([]byte) cast → data stored as corrupted string
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:anyToColumns函数在处理JSON字段时(line 1967-1968),直接将interface{}强制转换为[]byte,未做类型检查。当传入字符串而非JSON对象时,该转换静默成功但破坏了数据完整性(contract要求JSON字段存储JSON对象)→ 真缺陷

falsification.probe: Independent verification via query after upsert: query id=0 with outputFields=['meta'] shows meta="invalid_json" instead of expected JSON object
falsification.observed: Query confirms data corruption: original JSON object {"important": "data"} replaced with string "invalid_json"

excluded: API semantic misunderstanding (JSON dataType should enforce JSON structure)
By-design behavior (data integrity violation, not intentional)

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus; pattern: 'Data type serialization not validated'
cognition_match.note: 候选命中developer_cognition.json中rest-v2-data-type-handling模式: REST v2 API未能正确序列化/验证复杂数据类型,本例为JSON字段接受非JSON值并破坏数据完整性

verdicts.rationale: Upsert API接受JSON字段的非JSON值(字符串)并静默成功,导致数据从有效JSON对象 {"important": "data"} 被破坏为字符串 "invalid_json"。源码接地发现anyToColumns()函数在处理DataType_JSON时(line 1967-1968)直接进行interface{}到[]byte的强制转换,缺失类型检查。这不是by-design行为而是validation缺失缺陷,与历史bug_shapes.json中rest-v2-data-type-handling模式(26个实例,置信度0.95)完全吻合。
